title: Authorized fulfillment charge to payable-adjustment projection
purpose: Define the canonical pure translation from one trusted exact FOOD-005O authorized fulfillment charge candidate into the exact four-field charge-adjustment shape consumed by FOOD-005J, without constructing or mutating a payable assessment and without claiming the projected adjustment has been included in any assessment.
whyNow: FOOD-005O establishes exact authorized fulfillment-fee authority but intentionally does not mutate FOOD-005J or prove assessment inclusion.
FOOD-005J accepts explicit charge adjustments containing direction, reference, money and sourceReference.
FOOD-005J adjustment provenance is opaque and does not contain separate source ID/version fields.
Therefore a deterministic canonical translation is required before a later exact assessment-inclusion validator can compare an assessment against FOOD-005O without guessing.

contract.inputTrust: Input is one trusted FOOD-005O FoodAuthorizedFulfillmentChargeCandidate produced by the canonical FOOD-005O derivation. This slice is an internal pure composition seam, not an arbitrary transport decoder.
contract.reference: Deterministically encodes the exact FOOD-005M manual-approval identity and version from FOOD-005O.
contract.sourceReference: Deterministically encodes the exact FOOD-005N fulfillment-policy-decision identity and version from FOOD-005O.
contract.money: Copied exactly from FOOD-005O money with no repricing, rounding, fee calculation or mutation. Zero remains an explicit zero-valued charge adjustment.
contract.compatibility: The resulting object is structurally accepted by FOOD-005J as one explicit adjustment.
contract.immutability: The adjustment and nested money are detached and frozen.
contract.identityRule: Same money with different exact approval/policy identities must yield different canonical references.
contract.assessmentRule: Projection says what exact adjustment should be supplied to FOOD-005J. It does not assert that any FOOD-005J assessment actually contains it.

missing/duplicate authorized-adjustment detection inside an assessment
atomic inventory/slot persistence and race protection

future.assessmentInclusion: A later pure validator may rederive this exact projection from FOOD-005O and require exactly one matching adjustment in one exact FOOD-005J assessment while separately validating exact order binding.
future.duplicates: Missing or duplicate exact projected adjustments must fail closed.
future.readiness: Checkout/payment readiness remains downstream of explicit assessment inclusion proof and other independent readiness gates.
